question: Do both avatar profiles consistently refer to themselves in the correct Russian grammatical gender?

baseline: Current application, no product source changes in this audit
checks: All three seed openings for both profiles
Real generated first-person verbs and adjectives
metric: Manual count of avatar self-reference gender mismatches; neutral responses are inconclusive, not passes

stop_condition: No automatic retry, stop on credentials or quota error; do not change runtime settings or sessions
